title: Ethiopian Fir Fir Stew
description: A traditional Ethiopian fir fir stew made with lovely fir fir, charred spices, and injera bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until charred.
Add fir fir and cook for 5 minutes.
Add water, spices, and torn injera.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Garnish with additional injera and spices if desired.
Serve with additional fir fir if desired.
Serve with additional charred onion and garlic if desired.
Serve with additional olive oil if desired.
Serve with additional water if desired.
